The '''''Scout''-class 2-M repulsor tank''' or simply '''SC2-M Repulsor Tank''' was a ground-based [[Hovertank/Legends|fighter tank]] produced by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] and used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] variant of the [[2-M Saber-class repulsor tank/Legends|2-M ''Saber''-class repulsor tank]].<ref name="FiB" />
